intro.heading: Three levels of support, cumulative
intro.body: You're not choosing between different services — each level includes everything before it. The question is simply how far you want us to go with you.

comparisonNote: Each level builds on the one before it. Settled includes everything in Arrival, which includes everything in Admission.

whyNoPrices.heading: Why we don't list prices here
whyNoPrices.body: The right level of support — and its cost — depends on your country of origin, your university, and how much you already have in place. On the call, we look at your specific situation and give you a real number. No obligation to continue afterward.

notIncluded.heading: What no level includes
items: We don't issue visas — that decision belongs to the consulate alone.
We're not a real estate agency — we review and register contracts, we don't hold listings.
We don't guarantee outcomes on admission, visas, or housing. We prepare your file to the standard each authority expects.
